body: AUTHOR SELF-HOLD — do not authorize cand-6ETEZ2X4434TZPKAV1RFT8GFHY / 12f8468. During handoff review I found BenchChannels.neural publishes ChannelExposure.NonMemorizing. That contradicts the governing enum: a trained model whose weights may encode the story or summaries is Memorizing. Leaving it would let MiniLM enter the leakage-control baseline set and could make a contamination verdict invalid. This is substantive, not naming. I have asked the reviewer to stop. Repair: mark neural Memorizing, add a discriminating court, regenerate the committed WOG report, rerun exact-SHA scoped gates, propose successor, then formally supersede 6ETEZ.
